raw_record.question_text:

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Inspect the image component by component. Ignore all curved arrows. On the left aldehyde-like fragment, count the non-H bonds: R-C and C=O, while excluding C-H. On the right fragment, count the non-H bonds from the central carbon to R, to O⁻, and to OH, while excluding C-H and O-H. Add the left contribution 2 and the right contribution 3 to obtain 5.

method.method_draft: Convert the displayed structure into heavy-atom connectivity. The left R-CHO fragment has heavy-atom adjacencies R-C and C-O, giving 2 counted bonds; the C-H adjacency is discarded. The right R-CH(O⁻)(OH) fragment has heavy-atom adjacencies C-R, C-O⁻, and C-OH, giving 3 counted bonds; C-H and O-H are discarded. Summing the heavy-atom adjacencies across both displayed components gives 5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左上方显示一个 R-CHO 片段，其中羰基碳与 R 相连、与 O 形成双键、与 H 相连；右下方显示一个 R-CH(O⁻)(OH) 片段，其中中心碳与 R、H、带负电的 O、以及 OH 中的 O 相连。图中还有弯箭头，但题目说明要忽略箭头。推理：只统计非氢原子之间的键。左侧 R-CHO 中，R-C 和 C=O 是 2 个非氢键，C-H 不计。右侧 R-CH(O⁻)(OH) 中，C-R、C-O⁻、C-OH 是 3 个非氢键，C-H 和 O-H 不计。合计 2 + 3 = 5。
